title: What It Wants
body:
I ask interest-free for a loan,
not in money, but alone
a little emotion.

In this servile age of ours,
where they stand at attention for hours
for five work-stamps.

I ask for a conversation partner,
to speak without delay, harder
with honesty.

And not be like those who appear,
to whisper in your ear
obedient words.

I ask for an untamed soul
to get the 4x4 on a roll
for adventure,

and not from the couch, away
social media and a frappé,
arrogant jawline.

A free spirit I seek
and not even for a week
talk of commitment.

The world's conventional, high,
pointlessly submissive, why
to sterile inspiration.

In this desolate time,
whatever the soul asks to align
hardly ever comes.

I didn't try too hard, this path,
always a new kiss in the aftermath
will succeed it.

I don't want to admit state
that ever since I was eighteen
I've been searching for love.

And when I find it lounging about, no flaw,
I let a hundred labors thaw
to leave unyielding.
